evals.prompt: When should I use shallowRef vs ref in my Vue 3 component?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the reactivity topic and recommends shallowRef when deep reactivity is not needed, citing references/reactivity/reactivity--reactivity.md.
expectations: Routes via the topic routing table to references/reactivity/
Recommends shallowRef over ref when deep reactivity is unnecessary
Cites the canonical reference doc path

evals.prompt: How do I define props, emits, and a two-way v-model in a <script setup> SFC?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the data-flow topic and recommends defineProps / defineEmits / defineModel, citing references/data-flow/component-data-flow.md.
expectations: Routes to references/data-flow/component-data-flow.md
Recommends defineModel for two-way bindings
Notes that props are read-only in the child

evals.prompt: My large list re-renders on every keystroke. Should I use v-once, v-memo, or virtualize?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the perf topic and recommends v-memo and/or virtualization (useVirtualList), citing the perf reference docs.
expectations: Routes to references/perf/ docs
Recommends v-memo and/or list virtualization
Mentions the avoid-component-abstraction-in-lists rule

evals.prompt: How do I build a reusable composable that cleans up its listeners on unmount?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the composables topic and recommends onScopeDispose / tryOnScopeDispose for cleanup, citing references/composables/composables.md.
expectations: Routes to references/composables/composables.md
Recommends onScopeDispose for side-effect cleanup
Notes readonly state + options-object composable pattern

evals.prompt: I want a VueUse composable to detect clicks outside an element.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the vueuse-sensors category and recommends onClickOutside, picking by category not by name.
expectations: Routes to the vueuse-sensors/ topic
Recommends onClickOutside
Applies the VueUse 'pick by category, not by name' rule

evals.prompt: How do I persist reactive state to localStorage with VueUse?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the vueuse-state category and recommends useLocalStorage / useStorage.
expectations: Routes to the vueuse-state/ topic
Recommends useLocalStorage / useStorage
Cites with category-level routing

evals.prompt: My async-setup component suspends — how do I show a loading state with defineAsyncComponent?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the async topic and recommends defineAsyncComponent with loadingComponent (delay ~200ms) and errorComponent, citing references/async/component-async.md.
expectations: Routes to references/async/component-async.md
Recommends loadingComponent with delay near 200ms
Mentions errorComponent fallback

evals.prompt: What's the difference between <Transition> and <TransitionGroup>, and when do I use mode='out-in'?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the builtin topic and explains Transition (single) vs TransitionGroup (list, FLIP), citing references/builtin/component-transition*.md.
expectations: Routes to references/builtin/ docs
Distinguishes Transition vs TransitionGroup
Mentions mode='out-in' and move class / FLIP

evals.prompt: How do I safely scope CSS in a Vue SFC and bridge --yry-* tokens to --yry-doc-*?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the css topic and explains scoped CSS + the --yry-* to --yry-doc-* token bridge, citing references/css/css-architecture.md.
expectations: Routes to references/css/css-architecture.md
Explains the CSS @import chain and token bridge
Mentions scoped CSS

evals.prompt: I'm hitting SSR state leaks with a singleton composable in Nuxt. Should I use Pinia instead?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the state topic and recommends Pinia for SSR-safe shared state over singletons, citing references/state/state-management.md.
expectations: Routes to references/state/state-management.md
Recommends Pinia for SSR-safe shared state
Notes singletons leak across requests in SSR/Nuxt

evals.prompt: Please review my Vue 3 SFC for code quality issues against the yry-html-vue rules.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the review topic and produces a structured review that walks the checklist categories (script setup, reactivity, template, data flow, async, state, animation, composables, 4-file pattern) and cites references/review/code-review-checklist.md with severity-tagged issues.
expectations: Routes to references/review/code-review-checklist.md
Walks the checklist categories rather than freeform listing
Tags each issue with severity (Blocker / Major / Minor / Nit)
Cites a rule number and/or reference doc per issue

evals.prompt: Can you produce an optimization page report for components/DashboardPanel.vue? I want a list of what I can improve with severity, effort, and impact, plus a suggested sprint slice.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the optimize topic and produces a report following the six-section template (executive summary, performance, maintainability, accessibility, risk & effort matrix, suggested sprint slice) using references/optimize/optimization-report.md. Each opportunity uses the Location / Category / Effort / Impact / Why / Fix / Verification entry format.
expectations: Routes to references/optimize/optimization-report.md
Follows the six-section report shape (executive summary, performance, maintainability, accessibility, risk & effort matrix, suggested sprint slice)
Each opportunity uses Location / Category / Effort / Impact / Why / Fix / Verification
Cites a canonical reference doc per opportunity

evals.prompt: What's the difference between a code review and an optimization report? When should I use which?
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes the two deliverables: a code review (correctness against the checklist) vs an optimization report (opportunity list with severity / effort / impact). Routes to both review/ and optimize/ reference docs.
expectations: Routes to both references/review/ and references/optimize/
States the framing difference: correctness vs opportunity list
Names the canonical doc for each deliverable

evals.prompt: Review the following SFC: ```vue ``` Flag every issue against the yry-html-vue rules.
evals.expected_output: Walks the code-review-checklist and flags at minimum: missing lang="ts" (rule 3), missing TS on script setup, items could be shallowRef (rule 4), load() side effect without error handling or cleanup, v-for key uses index for an API-driven list (rule 10), v-html on server-supplied data (rule 11), and missing error state for the async fetch.
expectations: Routes to references/review/code-review-checklist.md
Flags the v-for index key on an API-driven list
Flags v-html on server-supplied data as a blocker (XSS)
Flags the missing lang="ts" on script setup
Suggests shallowRef for the items list and an error state for the async fetch
